title: Effect of lutein on improving traumatic temporomandibular joint fibrous ankylosis
html: This study investigated the therapeutic effects and potential mechanisms of lutein on traumatic temporomandibular joint (TMJ) fibrous ankylosis. A TMJ fibrous ankylosis model was established in rabbits, then randomly divided into a lutein-treated group and a model group (n = 8 per group), followed by daily oral administration of lutein (10 mg/kg) or saline for 4 weeks. Compared with the model group, the lutein group showed significantly higher body weight (P = 0.049), maximum mouth opening (P = 0.043), condylar surface area (P = 0.001), and condylar volume (P = 0.003).
